acceptanceCriteria: For a ticket (a gate ticket is just a ticket), it returns the transitive OPEN/HELD dependency closure as chains, longest unsatisfied chain first. For each node: status, first blocker code, live attempt ID, holder, stage, member, and last progress seq/time when observed, otherwise NOT_OBSERVED.
Bounded: at most 256 nodes and 32 chains (or owner-set bounds), with `truncated: true` and counts when exceeded. Cycles are reported with the existing CYCLE code, not looped.
A pure read: no lock and no writes (product invariant 4). JSON under a new profile `taskman-critical-path/0`, plus a short human form.
After T585 and T587b land, execution prerequisites and LOOP_DETECTED/ESCALATION_PENDING holds appear as node blockers. No duration estimates in v0; the field is NOT_OBSERVED (D8).
